name: page-fixes
description: Small fixes a reader applies to the page in front of them, exposed as a JS API at window.__tools.page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: The fixes this page offers, and which are on.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Turn a fix on or off.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Every fix off, and forget them for this site.

storage: localStorage key page-fixes:<host>, kept in the reader's browser
